objectives.label: Define measurable success criteria and build a representative eval suite before production code; select model-based versus code-based grading, choose eval workflow stages, and use evals to gate production changes.

facets.label: Translate business requirements into measurable success criteria, with separate quality, safety/privacy, p95 latency, and cost gates.
